Hero.headline_prefix: A website so people find you
Hero.subheadline: Construction, cleaning, plumbing, or landscaping, in Canada or the United States. From $499 USD, half to start, and the site stays in your name.

About.title: About
About.p1: I’m Jesús Salinas. I live in Vancouver and I have spent years building websites and software for businesses that already invoice. Your questions and the build itself come to me, and I handle both, in Spanish or English. I use AI as a working tool, and that is how I deliver fast and at a fixed price. Your own page carries no bots and no automated chat.
About.p2: When it is done I hand you the site with every login, in your name and in your accounts, ready to bring in customers. From that day it is completely yours, and you can change it or grow it whenever you need.

ValueProposition.title: Why a page
ValueProposition.headline: This is not about being online.
ValueProposition.description: It is about getting messages from customers.

search.title: They look you up before they decide.
search.desc: If they find nothing, or an abandoned Facebook page, they end up calling whoever does have a website.

whatsapp.title: They message you on WhatsApp.
whatsapp.desc: Your page has a button that opens your chat right away. The message lands on your phone and you answer your own customer. I stay out of your conversations.

ownership.title: The site is yours.
ownership.desc: In your name and in your accounts.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.headline: One page, a fixed price, no hourly billing.

one_language.title: One language
one_language.price: 550 CAD in Canada, $499 USD in the United States.
one_language.desc: One page with everything a customer needs in order to decide: what you do, the area you serve, up to twelve of your own photos, and the button to your WhatsApp. It works on a phone and includes one round of changes. It is structured so Google and AI assistants understand your trade and your area. You pay half to start, and the domain is in your name.

two_languages.title: Two languages
two_languages.price: 750 CAD in Canada, $699 USD in the United States.
two_languages.desc: The same page in Spanish and English. Not a second website, and not twice the work for you.

google_maps.title: Google Maps, optional
google_maps.price: 80 CAD in Canada, $59 USD in the United States.
google_maps.desc: I create or clean up your profile so you show on the map with your hours, your area, and your photos. When it is done I hand you every login and the profile is in your name.

domain_email.title: Email on your domain, optional
domain_email.price: 120 CAD for the first mailbox and 40 CAD for each additional one. In the United States, $89 and $30.
domain_email.desc: you@yourdomain.com running in Gmail, the one you already use. I set up the mail and your domain’s DNS, and I hand you every login. The monthly fee goes to Google, about $7 per person or C$9.20 in Canada. One mailbox is enough if you work alone, since info@ can land in the same inbox.

Offer.not_included: What is not included: an online store, apps, hosting, a domain, Google’s monthly fee, advertising, running your socials, or guaranteed positions on Google.

items.a: No. Everything is settled in writing, by email. If you would rather talk, we do a twenty-minute video call in Spanish, and afterwards I send you the agreement in writing: terms, customizations and price.

items.q: Who owns the domain and the hosting?
items.a: You do. Both are registered in your name and in your accounts, and when we finish I hand you every login.

items.q: Is email on my domain included in the price of the page?
items.a: No, that is separate. 120 CAD for the first mailbox and 40 CAD for each additional one, or $89 and $30 in the United States. The monthly fee goes to Google, not to me.

items.q: Do I pay you every month?
items.a: No. The page is paid once. The only thing that renews is your domain, once a year with your provider, and Google’s email if you decide to have it.

items.q: Will this put me first on Google?
items.a: Nobody can promise you that, and anyone who does is selling you smoke. What I do deliver is a page with its initial optimization already done: your trade, your area, your business details and the questions your customers ask, written so Google and AI assistants understand them. From there, where you show up depends on the information you give me, on your city, and on how many businesses like yours are already there.

items.q: Do you do monthly SEO work?
items.a: No. The optimization is included once, when I build the page: titles, area, business details and this block of questions. I do not sell monthly ranking campaigns or ads.

The clock starts when your material reaches me complete: photos, text, area and your WhatsApp number. From that moment you have the first version within three business days, and then your round of changes.

items.q: Does this work for a food business or another trade?
items.a: Yes, if your business is local and you handle your customers on WhatsApp. I specialize in construction, cleaning and home trades, so if yours is something else, write me and I will tell you straight whether it fits.
Half to start and half on delivery. In Canada by Interac, in Canadian dollars. In the United States by PayPal invoice, goods and services, in US dollars.
